name: jarvis
description: JARVIS AI Desktop Environment for Windows
author: JARVIS Engineering

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Vite,Electron" -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package:dir: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && electron-builder --dir -c.win.sign=null
scripts.package:installer: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && electron-builder -c.win.sign=null
